messages:
maria: Quick kickoff — Forge Edge EAP: we need to lock the NDA language + benchmark telemetry contract before we send lab access. target: next-week early access window.
ajay: NDA has been routed to legal, expect counters by EOD tomorrow. any input on what telemetry fields Forge requires?
kevin: For benchmarks, we need: throughput (tokens/s), p50/p95 latency, GPU memory traces, and a small tail-latency sample. also a reproducible run script.
sylvia: +1. For marketplace packaging we'll need a slimmed container and a list of required host drivers (NVIDIA/AMD) — Forge uses a custom kernel on their board, FYI.
maria: Good call. @kevin can you draft the run script + args? Put it in a gist and we'll add to the NDA appendix.
kevin: Will do. Draft command looks like:
```
python run_bench.py --model redwood-v1-8b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --iters 200 --log-format json --emit-kvtrace
```
kevin: Also adding an env var dump so they can map hardware counters: `cat /sys/devices/forge_hw/*` in the run artifact.
nolan: Shipping update: lab kit leaves Tuesday (prepaid courier). ETA lab arrival Wed. I can hold access until NDA signed and bench spec agreed.
maria: Perfect. We'll gate SSH creds until legal confirms. Also need to decide on embargo for any numbers published — propose 30 days after GA. thoughts?
ajay: Legal prefers 60 days for partner EAPs by default, can try 30 but need sign-off.
sylvia: 30 is tight for joint marketplace listing QA. Can we put a clause: internal embargo 30, public press embargo 60? That buys us time for packaging.
maria: OK let's propose that to Forge.
lab-coordinator-bot: Auto-check: lab slot allocated for Forge EAP 2026-04-14 to 2026-04-21. Reminder emails scheduled.
kevin: On telemetry collection: we'll produce a single zipped artifact with `bench.jsonl` (per-iter metrics), `kvtrace.tar.gz`, `env.txt`, and `run.sh`. Suggest we include a small README with checksums.
sylvia: For marketplace: marketing needs a 1‑page copy + logo + compliance cert matrix. I'll start a checklist.
maria: Action items: ajay — follow up legal NDA and embargo language; kevin — gist + run script by EOD today; sylvia — marketplace checklist + required assets; nolan — confirm courier tracking and hold policy. I'll sync with Forge PM after we have NDA draft.
ajay: noted. I'll ping legal and copy the Forge counsel.
nolan: courier confirmed, tracking will be posted to the thread when available.
maria: Thanks team. small ask: keep any preliminary numbers internal until we have final embargo sign-off. :lock:
kevin: ack. I'll add a consistent metric schema so Forge analysis is straightforward.
sylvia: tagging marketing/legal: @marketing-team @legal-team (external handles) — please standby for the packet.
maria: End of thread for now — will post NDA update here.
